# Toolzium — Complete AI Knowledge Base & Tool Catalog
> https://toolzium.com

Toolzium provides 570+ free, instant, privacy-friendly online utilities. Every tool operates entirely within the user's browser via client-side JavaScript / WebAssembly, ensuring maximum security and zero latency.
